scope: Universal commutative-ring cleared quadratic inverse-pair formula conditional on a norm inverse, not actual finite-field/integer-encoding/counter implementation or global Jacobian formalization. statement: theorem conjugate_product {R : Type} [CommRing R] (n a b : R) : a*a+n*b*(-b) = a^2-n*b^2 ∧ a*(-b)+b*a = 0
